editorial: Costa Rica has tropical temperatures throughout the year, but condensation levels vary.
We visited in October, which is the peak of the wet season (May to November), on account of which the cloud part of the cloud forests did not disappoint.

Owing to the timing of our visit, we skipped the beaches, which are best experienced during the dry season (December to April). There’s off course a tradeoff here as Monteverde may not be as ethereal as when the clouds descend on it.
